This artefact defines metadata structure only. Report-derived caveats such as provisional CPI month, sampling error, unnamed local currency and unconfirmed COICOP revision are represented here as extraction targets, not as populated metadata values.

The report provides no contact point, source URL, geographic coverage, metadata update date, institutional mandate, detailed survey sampling design, detailed data collection method or publication frequency; the MSD includes optional or local concepts where useful so a Metadata Set can record 'not stated' when populated.

The report contains two distinct statistical subjects: monthly CPI by consumption division and annual household spending by residence and expenditure quintile. This MSD separates dataflow-level reference metadata for those subjects instead of treating each table as a standalone MSD.

The report states that consumption divisions resemble COICOP but does not confirm the COICOP revision; therefore classification information is modelled as narrative reference metadata rather than a confirmed coded COICOP metadata representation.
The report uses 'local currency per household per month' but does not name the currency; therefore the MSD provides a narrative unit-measure note and does not assign an ISO 4217 currency code.
